rules.authentication: Firebase Auth mandatory for all non-public routes
rules.authorization: Least privilege RBAC enforced at Cloud Functions and Firestore Security Rules
rules.secrets: PayMongo secret keys and Firebase Admin credentials stored in Cloud Secret Manager only
rules.data_isolation: Customers access only their own sub-trees/documents. Delivery personnel access minimal assigned delivery data.
rules.client_trust: Never trust client price, quantity, totals, or payment state
